claims.text: RESOLVED ONCE. Re-reading the environment on every check would let anything that can set an env var in this process move the switch out from under a running loop; the path a loop was started with is the path it is stopped by.
claims.why: The __init__ computes self._path once and stores it; no re-reading occurs in this chunk.

claims.text: The permit path, frozen at construction.
claims.why: path property returns self._path which is set in __init__ and never reassigned.

claims.text: Why the switch latched, or ``None`` while it has not.
claims.why: reason property returns self._reason which is initialized to None and set later.

claims.text: NOT ``Path.exists()``. ``exists()`` swallows every OSError and answers False, so an ACL that denies us the marker would read as "no stop was requested" -- the precise fail-open this module exists to avoid. Only ``FileNotFoundError``/``NotADirectoryError`` mean absent; anything else means we could not tell, and could-not-tell is STOP.
claims.why: The function uses os.stat and catches FileNotFoundError/NotADirectoryError to return False; other OSError returns True with reason.

claims.text: Read the permit from disk. Never raises; defaults to stopped.
claims.why: All exceptions are caught and result in a SwitchState with running=False; no exception propagates.

claims.text: Every early return below is a STOP. There is exactly one ``running`` exit, and it is reached only after the token was positively read and no stop marker was found.
claims.why: The function has multiple early returns with running=False; the only path that returns running=True is after token == RUN_TOKEN check passes, but that code is not in this chunk. Claim is about structure: early returns are STOP (running=False), only one running exit. The chunk shows early returns are STOP; the running exit is not shown but claim refers to code outside chunk; however the claim is verifiable as far as chunk shows: all returns in chunk are STOP. The claim about exactly one running exit is uncheckable because the final return is not in this chunk. But the claim that early returns are STOP is kept.

observations.what: read_state does not call _marker_present; marker presence is not checked in read_state. The docstring of _marker_present suggests it is used elsewhere, but not in this chunk.
read_state uses a nested function halt that returns SwitchState with running=False. The docstring says 'defaults to stopped' which matches.
The __init__ sets _children_stopped = False but never uses it in this chunk; it may be used later.
